title: Teka-Teki Gaib
description: Three riddles a day from the ghosts: type your answer and {name} and her friends judge it. A new set every day.

how.en: Read each riddle and type your answer. Spelling does not have to be perfect, and English or Indonesian both work. Three riddles a day.
how.id: Baca tiap teka-teki lalu ketik jawabanmu. Ejaannya nggak harus sempurna, bahasa Indonesia atau Inggris boleh. Tiga teka-teki sehari.

en: Not today's riddles, perhaps. There are new ones tomorrow.
Hm. They were tricky. Try again tomorrow.
id: Mungkin bukan teka-teki hari ini. Besok ada yang baru.
Hm. Susah ya. Coba lagi besok.

en: Some right, some not. That is how it goes.
You have a good ear for riddles.
id: Ada yang benar, ada yang belum. Begitulah.
Kamu punya telinga bagus buat teka-teki.

en: All three. I am quietly impressed.
You solved every one. The ghosts are talking about it.
id: Semua kamu pecahkan. Para hantu lagi ngomongin kamu.

en: A perfect set. Come back tomorrow for more.
Three for three. That is rare.
id: Satu set sempurna. Besok balik lagi ya.

id.description: Tiga teka-teki sehari dari para hantu: ketik jawabanmu dan {name} bersama temannya yang menilai. Set baru tiap hari.
